lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of at least four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots. The centroids show a regular spatial distribution with approximately uniform horizontal and vertical spacing between adjacent nodes across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, specifically at the spot centroids, creating a discernible lattice or grid-like anchor system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminosity gradient (high-intensity highlight on the superior edge, shadow on the inferior edge) extending across the mid-body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of high-luminance linear striations and irregular white patches is visible on the dorsal surface posterior to the first dorsal fin. A dark, irregular mass or protrusion is visible on the dorsal midline immediately anterior to the leading edge of the first dorsal fin.
